title: Mining Revenue Schedule
description: Extension schema for the vwp-digital-assets-mining-revenue extension. Constrains a core calculation object of type 'miningRevenueSchedule': every block reward or pool payout with its units (block subsidy plus transaction fees for a solo miner; the payout for a pool participant), the unit price at the date the pricing basis fixes and the fact that price comes from, the fair value recognized, and the chain-observed total the schedule must tie to. Located by type under calculations/; one schedule per asset and arrangement.

chainObservedUnits.description: Reward units RECEIVED on chain in the period — coinbase outputs to the entity's addresses for a solo miner, pool payouts received for a participant (explorer, node, pool statement or Bitwave sync); recognized units reconcile to this through the unreceived balances.

chainObservedFact.description: Fact id for the chain-observed total.

date.description: The recognition date (per the timing judgment); must lie within periodStart..periodEnd.

units.description: Total units of the reward: block subsidy plus transaction fees for a solo miner (feeUnits records the fee part), or the payout amount for a pool participant.

priceFact.description: Fact id whose value is {price, date}: the price on measurementDate from the pricing source.

reference.description: Block hash or height (solo), payout id or transaction hash (pool) identifying the reward; unique across schedules.

inceptionOn.description: Contract inception for this reward (the mining activity or committed hosting/pool period it relates to); required when pricingDateBasis is contractInception.

receivedOn.description: The on-chain receipt date (coinbase output credited, or pool payout received); required when pricingDateBasis is receiptDate.

measurementDate.description: The date whose price measures the reward: inceptionOn, date or receivedOn per pricingDateBasis. The priceFact must state the price as of this date.

feeUnits.description: The transaction-fee part of the reward, when known; never more than units.

arrangement.description: Arrangement label (solo operation, pool account, hosting contract). Reward references must be unique and schedule periods must not overlap within one asset and arrangement.

pricingDateBasis.description: The date whose price measures each reward: contractInception (ASC 606-10-32-21 noncash consideration), recognitionDate (when control of the reward is obtained), or receiptDate (when the policy recognizes on receipt). The recognition-timing judgment decides this; later price movements are remeasurement, never mining revenue.

unreceivedOpeningUnits.description: Units recognized in earlier periods but received in this one (opening balance of earned-not-received rewards, e.g. pool payouts pending).

unreceivedClosingUnits.description: Units recognized in this period but not yet received at periodEnd (closing balance of earned-not-received rewards).

unreceivedClosingFact.description: Fact id for the closing unreceived balance (checked against its value when present).

otherReconcilingUnits.description: Other reconciling units (pool fees netted at source, orphaned or stale blocks reversed, immature coinbase excluded), explained in reconciliationNote.

operatorType.description: solo: the entity finds blocks with its own hash power and receives the coinbase output; poolParticipant: the entity contributes hash power and receives payouts under the pool's scheme; poolOperator: the entity runs the pool and receives the coinbase then distributes to participants (gross/net follows the principal judgment).
